# go-cli-tool

Welcome to **go-cli-tool**. This workspace is initialized with an AI-ready development contract generated by [Foundry](https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry).

## Application Profile
- **Application Type:** cli
- **Primary Language:** go
- **Guardrail Strictness:** standard

## Key Development Commands
- **Build:** `go build ./...`
- **Test:** `go test -v ./...`
- **Dev:** `go run main.go`
- **Lint:** `golangci-lint run`

## Working with AI Coding Assistants
This project maintains consistent, deterministic AI instruction files to ensure that AI assistants (such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot) follow project conventions and guardrails without manual prompt recreation:

- **AGENTS.md**: Standard root instructions for cross-tool AI agents.
- **Cursor (.cursor/rules/)**: Modular rules for Cursor IDE.

For the core architectural guidelines and non-negotiable rules governing this codebase, refer to [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md).
